[[File:DarkSideAdepts_swenc.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] Dark Side Adepts [[Gwellib Ap-Llewff]] and [[Savuud Thimram]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].]]
{{Quote|Foolish Jedi! These are ''dark side adepts'', worshipers of the Dark Lord Freedon Nadd! More than a match for little boys!|Queen Amanoa, to [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], about her Royal Guards|audio=DarkSideAdepts-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Dark side adepts''', or [[Darksider|'''darksiders''']], were individuals with the power to use the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. While all [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were dark side adepts, the term was not only applied to them, as non-Sith, such as the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] or tribalistic [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]]s. Dark Side Adepts were often found at the sides of various rulers whose dominion was fortified with dark side teachings, and usually acted as royal guards or advisors.

==History==
The prominence of Dark Side Adepts dated back as far as the ancient aristocracy of Onderon, under the leadership of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] and her husband, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]], in whose service acted as [[Royal Protector|Royal Guards]]. While both the King and Queen preferred to employ Adepts as their personal royal protectors, their [[Naddist army]]'s enlistment consisted mostly of Dark Side Adepts as well. The only well known Adepts under Ommin and Amanoa's service during that time were Ommin's personal aide [[Novar (Human)|Novar]], and the Dark Jedi [[Warb Null]]. After the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], nearly all of Onderon's Dark Side Adepts were wiped out; however, by [[3997 BBY]] some were still alive and practicing dark side traditions. Darksiders [[Rask]] and [[Nebo]] were two such individuals.

During the tenure of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], any [[darksider]] other than [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ([[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious), the current [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]] of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]], was considered a Dark Side Adept. More specifically, the term referred to any darksider in an administrative position within the Galactic Empire, especially after Emperor Palpatine's resurrection into clone bodies.<ref name="DE Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The exact number of Adepts during Palpatine's reign remains unknown; however, it is known that the total number of his Adepts exceeded six hundred.

Palpatine planned to eventually replace all officials in the Galactic Empire with [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] Adepts.<ref name="DE Sourcebook " /> The highest ranking Adepts were the members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. Other Adepts included the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]], the [[Dark Side Elite]], the [[Byss Mage]]s, the imperial [[Force Adept (Imperial)|Force Adepts]], several of the [[Imperial Sovereign Protector]]s, the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]]s, several of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]], the first generation of [[Imperial Sentinel]]s, the [[Saber Guard]]s, the [[Imperial Sith Acolyte]]s, [[Senior Dark Side Adept]]s, the [[Nightsister Sith witch]]es, the [[Brothers of the Sith]], the [[Terror Biodroid]], the [[Seven Dark Jedi]], the [[Aberrant clone|Aberrant Clone]], the [[Order of Shasa]] (during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], at least) and various Imperial [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].
